selection.rule: Highest mean macro-F1 over the 4 leave-one-wilderness-area-out folds; a simpler model within 0.01 macro-F1 of the best wins (softmax < MLP < forest). Written before any LOAO result (docs/notes.md section 3).

ablations.description: The deployed contract: FEATURE_NAMES from @graze/features (9 values).
Contract features without the three hillshade columns.
Contract features without horizontal/vertical distance to water.
Contract features plus the excluded original columns: distance to roads and fire points, 4 wilderness-area and 40 soil-type indicators. Evaluation only; generated terrain has none of these.

importance.method: Permutation importance: mean drop in macro-F1 when one feature is shuffled (3 repeats, up to 20000 validation rows per fold)

generatedTerrain.generator: packages/sim/terrain generateTerrain, Sandbox page on load: relief 0.2, band center 0.4, 12% water, roughness 0.5, valley 0.35, seeds 1-20 (water cells excluded), inputs from @graze/features heightmapToSamples. Detector only; the app-level rates are in walkMode below.

walkMode.generator: packages/sim/terrain generateTerrain (Role 1), inputs from @graze/features heightmapToInputs, predicted by the app engine; water cells excluded
walkMode.flagDefinition: flaggedRate = cells the app marks low trust (OOD detector over threshold OR any input outside its training range). detectorFlaggedRate and outsideTrainingRangeRate split it and sum to flaggedRate.
